title: Interactive Analysis of Global Explanations using Aggregated Class Activation Maps for Network Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.13575v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent machine learning (ML) advances have demonstrated that deep learning (DL) achieves impressive results in different application domains, including the classification of computer network traffic to corresponding applications. However, the data frequently contains diverging patterns within a single predicted class. This presents a significant challenge to the ability to provide a clear and comprehensive explanation and emphasizes the necessity for tools capable of detecting and analyzing these patterns. Furthermore, the capacity to extract descriptive rules for classes is a crucial requirement in network traffic analysis and intrusion detection, particularly when leveraging advanced tools like next-generation firewalls. We provide a visual-interactive system that explains predictions of classes for network traffic. Global explanations derived from multiple samples of a given class contribute to understanding model predictions. Visua

translated_title: 基于聚合类激活图的网络数据全局解释交互式分析
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13575v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：近期机器学习（ML）的进展表明，深度学习（DL）在不同应用领域取得了显著成果，包括将计算机网络流量分类到相应应用程序。然而，数据中经常包含单个预测类别内的分歧模式。这对提供清晰全面的解释能力构成了重大挑战，并强调了检测和分析这些模式的工具的必要性。此外，提取类别的描述性规则是网络流量分析和入侵检测中的关键需求，尤其是在利用下一代防火墙等高级工具时。我们提供了一个可视化交互系统，用于解释网络流量类别的预测。从给定类别的多个样本中得出的全局解释有助于理解模型预测。Visua（视觉交互系统）
tldr: 本文提出一个可视化交互系统，通过聚合类激活图生成全局解释，帮助分析网络流量分类中的分歧模式，并提取描述性规则以增强模型预测的可理解性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a visual-interactive system that generates global explanations using aggregated class activation maps to analyze diverging patterns in network traffic classification and extract descriptive rules for improved model interpretability.
